subject: maths
question: AB is the chord of a circle such that AB = 10 cm. If the diameter of the circle is 20 cm, then the angle subtended by the chord at the centre is ________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius of the circle (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 20 cm ÷ 2 = 10 cm.

Given Chord length (AB) = 10 cm.

In ▵OAB (O is centre), sides are: OA = 10 cm, OB = 10 cm, and AB = 10 cm.

Since all three sides are equal (10 cm), ▵OAB is an equilateral triangle.

Internal angle of an equilateral triangle is always 60 degree.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Chord AB = 10 cm

Diameter = 20 cm

**Formula:**

Radius (r) = Diameter / 2

In a triangle with sides a, b, and c, if a = b = c, then the triangle is equilateral and the angle is 60°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a68c0500cdf225627e63da1cd39589d8aef1594e480593c47da133eee0f7829.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ Radius (r) = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

⇒ In ▵OAB, OA = radius = 10 cm

⇒ OB = radius = 10 cm

⇒ AB = chord = 10 cm (Given)

⇒ OA = OB = AB = 10 cm

⇒ Since all sides are equal, ▵OAB is equilateral.

⇒ ∠AOB = 60 degree.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 degree.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle at Centre and Circumference

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

Equilateral Triangle Property

In an equilateral triangle, all sides are equal and each interior angle measures exactly 60 degree.

Angle in a Semi-circle

The angle subtended by the diameter (the longest chord) at any point on the circumference is always 90 degree.</p
